title: Fallout Shelter Descent
description: A man in an orange jumpsuit and respirator walks down a dilapidated concrete staircase inside a flooded fallout shelter marked 732. Floating debris, film reels, broken picture frames, and a 'DANGER RADIATION' sign drift in the air as colorful beams of red, green, and yellow light pierce through a broken ceiling skylight, casting rainbow reflections on the water below.
